name: io.github.jamesK1000011/agentlink-freecad
title: Agent Link for FreeCAD
description: Drive FreeCAD from an agent: model, measure, check, draw and export parts, headless or live.

environmentVariables.name: FREECAD_APP
environmentVariables.description: Only if FreeCAD is not where its installer puts it: the path to the FreeCAD app or folder.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTLINK_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: "full" lists every tool at the start; by default the list starts lean and grows by group.
